weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 752 g for the 1991 FC-M550 SG triple reference: 170 mm crank arms with 48/38/28T chainrings; excludes the separately listed BB-M550 bottom bracket. The weight line does not distinguish the available Biopace SG and round SG chainring profiles.
